CustomField.formula: IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Next_Action_Date__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'Follow Up'), ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'Visit Proposed'), ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'Visit Done'), ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'Open'), ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'No Show'), ISPICKVAL(Latest_PreSales_Call_Status__c,'Visit Confirmed') ), DATEVALUE(Next_Action_Date__c) < TODAY() ), TODAY() - DATEVALUE(Next_Action_Date__c), 0)
CustomField.label: PreSales Call Ageing
